control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 %, then if the left light is below 45 % curve left, else if the line tracker reads above 95 % curve right, else avoid walls; otherwise avoid walls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 %, then if an obstacle is on the left turn right 20°, else if on the right turn left 20°, else drive in the dark; otherwise drive in the dark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 % drive forward at 30 %, else stop at a wall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead stop, else follow the line.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left 10/40, else curve right 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when there is one under the robot, drive straight when there is none; in the light, follow the line.
